paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The effect of context masking on case tasks groupby by language family. Error bars indicate the standard deviation.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks, grouped by language family. The horizontal axis represents the language family, displaying a sequence of categories including ‘IE-Baltic’, ‘IE-Germanic’, ‘IE-Indic’, ‘IE-Romance’, ‘IE-Slavic’, ‘IE-other’, ‘Isolate’, ‘Semitic’, and ‘Uralic’. The vertical axis represents the ‘effect’ value, with a linear scale ranging from approximately 0 to 30, marked with tick intervals of 5 units. Each bar corresponds to a specific language model, with the different colors representing the following models: mBERT-L2 (yellow), mBERT-R2 (orange), XLM-L2 (grey), mBERT-R2 (brown), XLM-R2 (dark green), mBERT-B2 (red), and IE-Romance (purple). The tallest bar, representing mBERT-L2, reaches a value of approximately 27, while the shortest bar, representing mBERT-R2, reaches a value of approximately 16. Error bars, indicating the standard deviation, extend upwards and downwards from each bar, with values ranging from approximately -3 to 23.  The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and none are visually emphasized.
